ITEM 1 | Single irregular piece of meat-like food, reddish-brown with pinkish interior showing at center, seared/browned edges with darker crust, slightly glossy and moist surface, roughly 6 cm by 4 cm with ragged torn edges, about 1 cm thick, holding its shape, sitting on the left-center area of the plate | 60
ITEM 2 | Chopped green herb mixture, bright and dark green flecks with small leaves and a thin stem, scattered over the top of the meat piece, slightly moist, loose and fine-textured, covering about a third of the piece, roughly 4 cm by 3 cm, under 1 cm thick | 8
